problems.problem: Koodiyattam was inscribed on UNESCO's Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage in 2008; 2001 refers to its earlier proclamation as a Masterpiece of the Oral and Intangible Heritage of Humanity.
problems.verifierReason: Koodiyattam inscribed on UNESCO Representative List 2008; 2001 was Masterpiece proclamation. Correction accurate.

problems.problem: Misspelling of the name of the fourth member of the Tanjore Quartet.
problems.verifierReason: The fourth brother of the Tanjore Quartet is universally recorded as Vadivelu (or Vadivelu Pillai). 'Vadivel ivelu' is a clear typographical error.

problems.quote: The Akademi also administers the prestigious Sangeet Natak Akademi Award and the Tagore Ratna
problems.problem: The Sangeet Natak Akademi does not administer a "Tagore Ratna" award; it administers the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award and the Sangeet Natak Akademi Fellowship (Ratna Sadsya). The Tagore Award is a separate Government of India award.
problems.correction: The Akademi also administers the prestigious Sangeet Natak Akademi Award and the Sangeet Natak Akademi Fellowship (Ratna Sadsya).
problems.verifierReason: SNA administers Fellowship (Ratna Sadsya), not 'Tagore Ratna'; Tagore Award is separate GoI scheme.

problems.quote: In 2009 the tabla was inscribed on UNESCO’s Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity as part of the “Traditional Indian Percussion” entry
problems.problem: The tabla is not inscribed on UNESCO's Representative List; there is no "Traditional Indian Percussion" entry on the list.
problems.correction: The tabla is not on UNESCO's Representative List; it is transmitted through guru-shishya parampara and institutional curricula.
problems.verifierReason: Tabla not on UNESCO ICH list; 2009 inscription was Ramman. No 'Traditional Indian Percussion' entry exists.
